title: Workflow Runtime
description: A fixed review pipeline executes inside one Workflow call, records a journal, emits lifecycle and progress events, and returns one final tool result.

steps.content: Review this change across correctness, security, performance, and style.

steps.annotation: One tool call hands deterministic orchestration to the workflow runtime.
The runtime emits launch lifecycle events before it executes the script; this is not a tool result.
Each item advances independently through the scripted stages.

steps.annotation: Structured results cross a validation boundary before aggregation.
Every completed agent call is checkpointed as the script runs.
The task emits its final lifecycle event after output is written.
The completed call returns once, with launch metadata, the workflow result, and task state together.
The main loop receives that single result and continues with the updated conversation.
